name: wailing_caverns
notes: Wailing Caverns (map 43), mapped offline from the world database export of tortoise-wow (tools/dungeongen/testdata/map43, read with export.sh; re-exported 2026-10-15 and identical), the instance script src/scripts/dungeons/wailing_caverns (instance_wailing_caverns.cpp, wailing_caverns.cpp) and the navmesh tiles of map 43 (~/tb-ci/mmaps-turtle043 on yulon-ubuntu2). The status stays 'draft (not mapped, not live-checked)': it was written offline and nobody has walked it, and 'mapped' means after the in-game GM-invisible walk; dungeon_run refuses a draft without allow_draft. Wowhead's Classic guide page does not hand its text to a fetch (it is rendered by script), so the tips come from the core's creature_spells and EventAI tables (the spell ids in the tactics blocks) and the Icy Veins, Almar's Guides and Warcraft Tavern guides.

ROUTE (about 5170 yd of navmesh path from the entrance to Verdan by the first member of each group, 5990 yd with every member position, 12 legs, 89 pull groups with 174 mobs, 8 patrols): the cave mouth and Lady Anacondra's four possible spots (anacondra_a, anacondra_b), north to Lord Cobrahn (cobrahn_a to cobrahn_c; 861 yd from the last Anacondra spot, a dead end), back through the cave mouth and down the long south road to Lord Pythas (pythas_a to pythas_c), Skum in the far south-west (skum, a 372 yd dead end), the west column up to the foot of the ramp (west_column) and the hop onto it (serpentis: Lord Serpentis, then verdan: Verdan the Everliving). The order is the shortest of the ones tried (the four Fanglords all lie on dead-end branches; the other orders came to 6900 yd and more). The Disciple of Naralex event comes after Verdan and is in dungeons/wailing_caverns-extra.json, because the driver cannot do it yet.

The four Fanglords (Lady Anacondra 3671, Lord Cobrahn 3669, Lord Pythas 3670, Lord Serpentis 3673) are what unlock the Disciple event: instance_wailing_caverns.cpp opens the Disciple's second gossip menu (202, 'Let the event begin!') only when all four are DONE. Skum (3674), Verdan (5775) and Kresh (3653) are not part of it. Mutanus the Devourer (3654) has no spawn row; the escort script summons him.

Lady Anacondra has FOUR spawn rows (guids 27366, 1177978, 1177979, 1177980) in one spawn pool (pool_template 10004, max_limit 1): one of -67.8 122.6 -89.9, 46.5 184.0 -89.2, 15.3 297.2 -87.7 and -54.0 271.4 -92.8 is up per reset. The plan has no boss for her (a boss has one position) and no way to say 'one of these'. Instead each spot is a one-member pull group at the point of the road where the party passes it (group 11 of anacondra_a, groups 6 and 12 of anacondra_b and group 3 of cobrahn_a, radius 15): a group whose member is not in view is looked at, and the driver walks on when it sees none. Whichever spot is up gets pulled as a pack of one; the other three are looked at and found empty. NOT tested live. The proper fix is a boss with alternative positions (see the pull request text).

The hop: the navmesh of map 43 has two parts that do not touch. The big one holds everything from the cave mouth to Skum; the other (331 polygons, z -64 to -21) is the winding ramp up to the Serpentis hall with Serpentis and Verdan. The only place the two come near each other is the foot of the ramp: -293.3 0.5 -58.0 (main mesh) and -289.1 3.2 -64.1 (ramp), 4.9 yd across and 6.1 down; every other contact is 28 yd or more up or down. The leg 'serpentis' crosses it with a direct step (via, check_skip: the plan check cannot judge a step over a gap of the mesh). It is the one step of this plan that the mapping walk must prove: if the real ramp starts somewhere else, only that hop changes.

No team gate is needed: every mob of the route is hostile to both teams (faction 270 Deviate, 14 Skum and the oozes). Left out of the pull groups on purpose: the level-1 Snakes (2914, 40 of them) and Biletoads (3835), Kresh (3653, the turtle that walks the river, faction 7, neutral: he is never pulled and is in every leg's skip list), the rare Deviate Faerie Dragon (5912, skip), the Disciple of Naralex (3678) and Naralex (3679), faction 35. Four packs that stand on a lower or higher floor the route only looks across (a walk of 165 to 234 yd from the road: crocolisks in the river at z -106 and a Shambler and a Venomwing pocket) are not in a group either; they stay asleep unless the party walks into them.

Left out because they are not on the way to a boss: the Turtle-added west wing (map x -400 to -550: Vangros 61965, Kolkar Truthseeker 61966 and Explorer 61967, Unnatural Overgrowth 61964, a Deviate Coiler Hatchling 61218; the navmesh holds it as a separate 7700-polygon part reached from the south-west) and Zandara Windhoof (61968, 81.9 27.0 -66.8, a rank-1 named mob on a spur east of the road, 334 yd from Pythas), the giant pillar cavern at x -380 to -160, y 80 to 340 (its own mesh part, no spawn rows worth a route), the Kresh river. The bonfires and chests of the export (Large Battered Chest 75293, the Mysterious Wailing Caverns Chest 180055 of the Fortune Awaits quest) are not used by the plan.

Entry: the portal is area trigger 228 (map 1, -753.6 -2212.8 21.5, radius 13, required level 10; the same trigger row sends to map 43 at -158.441 131.601 -74.2552, the plan's entrance). Unlike Zul'Farrak this dungeon has game_tele rows on both sides: 205 'wc' (map 43, -163.5 132.9 -73.7, inside, the plan's entrance_tele) and 130 'WailingCaverns' (map 1, -731.6 -2218.4 17.0, outside, outside_tele). A GM leader is put inside with `.tele name <bot> wc`; any other leader enters with `cmd enter 228` at the portal (TortoiseBots #939). Row 448 'path1' (137.2 254.0 -100.3) is a GM tele into Naralex's chamber, useful for testing the final event on its own.

CC and kill order (plan fields): the Druids of the Fang (3840, humanoid, level 19-20, 1450-1550 hp) cast Sleep (700) and Healing Touch (5187) and Lightning Bolt (9532) and run at 15 percent (EventAI 384001, 80 percent of the time): they are cc_priority (the mage's Polymorph), kill_first and fleers. Skum (3674) also runs at 15 percent (EventAI 367402). Evolving Ectoplasm (3640, type 'not specified', walks as a patrol) cannot be crowd-controlled and becomes immune to a school for 10 s after it is hit by it (npc_evolving_ectoplasm: fire, frost, nature, shadow): change schools or use physical damage. Deviate Shamblers (5761, type elemental in the database) cast Wild Regeneration at 50 percent hp (kill them fast or interrupt), Deviate Dreadfangs (5056) Terrify (5s fear), Deviate Lashers (5055) Wide Slash, Deviate Adders (5048) poison on hit; a pack of Python (8886) at Cobrahn dies to area damage.

Patrols: 8 patrols of the export (creature_movement waypoints, walking at 2.5 yd/s, closing the loop; the period_s of each is an estimate from the path length, not a timing) are attached to the group they pass nearest (within 40 yd) as the group's patrol, the patrolling mob itself left out of the group's entries; the other five (Kresh, a Deviate Shambler at 22.8 -150.8 off the south road, Kolkar Truthseeker 61966 and two Shamblers of the west wing) are not on the route. Patrols are not placed at the start position: the plan lists the waypoint path; a patrol that is met is fought like any mob.

Checks done offline: the plan check (`turtle-agent plan-check --mmaps ~/tb-ci/mmaps-turtle043 wailing_caverns`: every hop, pull look and boss walk on the navmesh; the one direct hop is exempt with check_skip), TestWailingCavernsOnNavmesh (the whole route is complete navmesh paths, 5990 yd to every position, and the plan holds the four Fanglords, the four Anacondra spots and the hop) and the generic plan tests. 107 yd of the road to Cobrahn and 308 yd of the road back are shallow-water polygons (wading, flag ground+water); none is deep water. First live job: the GM-invisible mapping walk: every pull group's positions, the hop, the loop at -345 22 -101 and the spiral to Cobrahn.

notes: Cave mouth to the first of Lady Anacondra's four spots (-67.8 122.6 -89.9, the last group): trash of Deviate Ravagers (3636, beasts), Guardians (3637) and Druids of the Fang, and two Evolving Ectoplasm patrols (groups 4 and 5). legs.name: anacondra_b
notes: Spot 2 (46.5 184.0 -89.2) and spot 3 (15.3 297.2 -87.7) of Lady Anacondra are the last groups of each stretch. The guides say she calls every raptor within about 100 yd when pulled, so the trash before her spot is cleared first (not in the database's EventAI, which has only her yell and her Nature Channeling 13236 out of combat). Her spells: Thorns Aura 8148, Healing Touch 5187, Sleep 700 (interrupt it) and Lightning Bolt 9532.

legs.name: cobrahn_b
notes: The road north climbs in a loop from the river at z -106 to z -54 (the plan check walks it): Deviate Adders (5048), Vipers (5755) and Python (8886) with Druids of the Fang (3840: Sleep and Healing Touch, kill or Polymorph first).

legs.name: cobrahn_c
notes: Lord Cobrahn (3669, -151.1 414.4 -72.6, humanoid druid, level 20, 4389 hp): the last group (three Deviate Pythons, 8886, at his feet, 3 yd from him) is pulled first, so the party can use area damage on them; Cobrahn casts Druid's Slumber (8040, an 8 s sleep on one member) and Lightning Bolt (9532), and below 30 percent hp changes into a serpent for a while (EventAI 366903, Cobrahn Serpent Form 7965) and then back. Interrupt the casts. His gem is part of the Leaders of the Fang quest.

legs.name: pythas_c
notes: Lord Pythas (3670, 36.8 -241.1 -79.5, level 21, 5110 hp): his Druid of the Fang (3840) and a Shambler stand 14 yd from him and join (last group); Sleep (700), Healing Touch (5187), Lightning Bolt (9532): interrupt, kill the Druid first. His table also holds Thunderclap (8147, an area slow around him): keep the party out of melee range of it.

legs.name: skum
notes: Skum (3674, -285.7 -313.7 -69.2, level 21 beast, 6944 hp): immune to nature, casts Chained Bolt (6254, interruptible), runs at 15 percent (fleers: the driver waits for him to come back with the next group). Optional in the game's quests but the party passes him anyway: the west column to Serpentis starts at his hall, 340 yd away.

notes: Starts with the hop from -293.3 0.5 -58.0 to -289.1 3.2 -64.1 (via 2, direct, check_skip: the navmesh has a seam there, see the plan notes; NOT walked live), then up the ramp past Shamblers and Druids to Lord Serpentis (3673, -120.2 -24.6 -28.6, level 21, 4289 hp): Sleep (700), Healing Touch (6778), Lightning Bolt (9532), no adds; he yells when the first of the other three Fanglords dies (SERPENTIS_YELL). legs.name: verdan
notes: Verdan the Everliving (5775, -81.9 32.3 -31.0, level 21 elemental, 8099 hp, 69 yd from Serpentis): hits harder than anyone before him, Grasping Vines (8142, a root of 10 s, not interruptible; ranged stay 10 yd off), no adds. The game's shortcut behind him is a hole that drops into the river near the entrance; a fall is no plan step, so the way back to the Disciple is the same 1700 yd, through the hop upwards (see dungeons/wailing_caverns-extra.json).
